status.active: Active on your local network · Paired devices: {count}
action.pauseHint: While paused, no tablet can press keys on this PC
alert.pairingAttempts: There were many failed pairing attempts, so pairing was paused for a minute. If it wasn't you, someone on your network is trying to connect.
connect.intro: To pair a tablet, scan whichever QR works with its camera. The others simply won't open. Each QR works for one device only.
connect.codeHint: To type it on the tablet by hand. It expires in {time} or once used, and renews itself.
connect.thisPcHint: Use shards on this screen, no tablet needed
devices.intro: Each paired tablet has its own key. Unpairing one disconnects it at once; it will have to scan the QR again.
devices.none: No devices are paired yet. Go to Connect and scan a QR with the tablet.
devices.name: Device name
shards.dropHint: You can also drag a .zip, a .libreshard file or a folder onto this window.
shards.dropHere: Drop the shard here to review it
shards.pendingIntro: Shards with pending permissions: {count}. Their new keys won't work until you review and approve them.
shards.installed.toast: "{name}" is installed and already shows up on the tablet.
risk.warning: Warning: this shard can open the system's "Run" box (or similar shortcuts) and also type text and press Enter. With that it could run any command on your PC. Only install it if you trust its author.
risk.system: This shard uses system shortcuts (Windows key, Alt+F4 or Ctrl+Alt). Check that they make sense for what it does.
risk.canType: This shard can type free text and press Enter.
risk.noApps: It isn't limited to any app: its keys act on whatever app is in the foreground.
review.updateFrom: It will be updated from version {from} to {to}.
review.pendingKeys: Unapproved keys: {count} (marked in gold). They won't work until you approve them.
review.keys: Keys it will be able to press ({count})
settings.portHint: Only change it if another program uses 7878. Tablets will have to scan the new QR.
settings.confirmDevicesHint: Every time a tablet tries to pair, this PC will ask you before accepting it.
settings.publicNetworksHint: When off, only devices on your local network or on a VPN such as Tailscale are accepted. Only turn it on if you know what you're doing.
settings.restartNeeded: Restart LibreShard to apply the changes.
about.title: About
about.license: Free and open source software under the Apache 2.0 license.
about.problemsHint: "Report a bug" copies the diagnostics and opens the report form on GitHub; paste them in its last field and read everything before sending. The diagnostics and the log have no device names, network addresses or keys typed.
about.reportOpened: Diagnostics copied: paste them in the form's last field and read them before sending.
dialog.portInUse:
Port {port} is already used by another program.

Close that program, or change "port" in this file and open LibreShard again:
{file}

If you change the port, tablets will have to scan the new QR.
dialog.confirmDevice.detail: A device with IP {ip} wants to pair using the current code or QR.
dialog.removeDevice.detail: It will be disconnected at once and will have to scan the QR again to use LibreShard.
dialog.uninstall.detail: Its folder will be deleted from the shards folder.
dialog.uninstall.detailLinked: It's a link to a development folder: only the link is removed, your files are left alone.
apps.title: Where it acts
apps.modeAnyHint: Its keys act on whatever app is in the foreground.
apps.modeOnlyHint: If you tap a button with another app in front, nothing is pressed and the tablet says so.
apps.empty: Add at least one app, or choose "In any app".
apps.detectHint: Bring the app you want to add to the front before the countdown ends.
apps.detectFailed: The foreground app couldn't be detected.
apps.detectSelf: LibreShard was still in front. Click "Detect app" and switch to the app you want before the countdown ends.
apps.noneOpen: No other apps have an open window.
apps.textTitle: Or type part of the name
apps.textHint: Matches any program whose name contains that text. Picking the app is more precise.
apps.titleOnly: This PC can only read the window title: the text is looked for in the title.
apps.saved: Saved: “{name}” now uses the new apps.
apps.restored: The suggested apps for “{name}” were restored.
settings.allowAppsFromTabletHint: When a shard doesn't act because another app is in front, the tablet offers "Allow here too" and adds that app.
settings.panelAlwaysOnTop: Keep this PC's panel on top
settings.panelAlwaysOnTopHint: The panel window stays above every other window.
viewer.title: Your shards
viewer.subtitle: Pick one to open it full screen.
viewer.paused: LibreShard is paused on the PC: no keys are pressed
viewer.offline: No connection to the PC. Reconnecting…
viewer.pairPrompt: Scan the QR on the PC or type the pairing code LibreShard shows
viewer.pending: Waiting for you to accept this device on the PC…
viewer.blocked: Not run. This shard only works in {apps}.
viewer.blockedSelf: Nothing was pressed: LibreShard is in front. Switch to the app you want to control first.
viewer.updateAvailable: LibreShard was updated on the PC. Reload to use the new version.
viewer.blockedElevated: Nothing was pressed: {app} runs as administrator and ignores keys from LibreShard. Close LibreShard and open it as administrator too.
viewer.panelReopen: The panel lost its connection to LibreShard. Close it and open it again from the "This PC" card.
viewer.activeUnknown: The active app couldn't be detected.
viewer.allowed: Done: this shard now works in {app} too. Tap the button again.
viewer.allowFailed: The app couldn't be added. Tap the button again with that app in front.
viewer.revoked: This device is no longer paired. Scan the QR on the PC or type the pairing code.
viewer.qrUsed: This QR was already used or expired. Scan the one the PC shows now, or type the code.
viewer.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} s and try again.
viewer.noConnection: Couldn't connect to the PC. Check that LibreShard is open.
viewer.fullscreenFailed: The browser didn't allow full screen.
viewer.autoFullscreenHint: When you pick a shard from the menu. Saved on this device only.
viewer.noShards: No shards are active. Install one from the LibreShard window on the PC.
viewer.pendingPerms: Pending permissions: review them on the PC
viewer.listFailed: The shard list couldn't be loaded.
viewer.keyUnavailable: This PC's keyboard has no {keys} key, so it wasn't pressed.
viewer.focusPaused: Paused: this shard acts in {apps}. {app} is in front now.
viewer.focusUnknown: Paused: the PC can't tell which app is in front.
review.linkNote: The folder is linked, not copied: every time you save a file, the tablet reloads the shard. If you add keys to the manifest, you'll have to approve them again.
shardSettings.title: Shard settings
shardSettings.hint: The shard gets the changes right away, without reloading.
shardSettings.restored: The default settings for “{name}” were restored.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: Tablets keep working with the window closed. To quit completely, use "Quit" on the tray icon.
settings.openAtLoginHint: LibreShard starts with the system, showing only the tray icon.
panel.title: LibreShard · This PC
tray.stillRunning: LibreShard is still running in the tray. Tablets can keep using it.
dialog.pickDevFolder: Choose the folder of the shard you're developing
shards.orderHint: This is the order of the tablet's menu. Favorites (★) come first; the arrows move each shard within its group.
